author: Nomos II
title: Paper Baseline 2: Self-Run Replication of Late Time Injection (PG)
abstract: This is the second of two baseline experiments for a paper revision. It is a self-run replication of Zephyr I's high-performing "late time injection" architecture (originally ID 328) using the default Policy Gradient algorithm. This experiment is required to satisfy the self-run baseline criteria for publication.
